failures.question: I want to analyze how the Signal-to-Noise Quality Indicator (SNQI) varies across different weather conditions. For each weather condition, give weather condition name, the average SNQI, the median SNQI, and count how many analyzable signals there are. Sort the result by average SNQI in descending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH snqi_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.signalregistry,
        o.WeathProfile,
        s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) AS snqi
    FROM signals s
    JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        WeathProfile,
        AVG(snqi) AS avg_snqi,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN snqi > 0 THEN 1 END) AS analyzable_count
    FROM snqi_data
    GROUP BY WeathProfile
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        WeathProfile,
        snqi,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile ORDER BY snqi) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile) AS cnt
    FROM snqi_data
)
SELECT 
    g.WeathProfile,
    g.avg_snqi,
    (SELECT AVG(r.snqi) 
     FROM ranked r 
     WHERE r.WeathProfile = g.WeathProfile 
       AND r.rn BETWEEN (r.cnt+1)/2 AND (r.cnt+2)/2) AS median_snqi,
    g.analyzable_count
FROM grouped g
ORDER BY g.avg_snqi DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH signal_quality AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) AS SNQI, o.WeathProfile FROM Signals s JOIN Telescopes t ON s.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry JOIN Observatories o ON t.ObservStation = o.ObservStation ), ranked_quality AS ( SELECT WeathProfile, SNQI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile ORDER BY SNQI) as row_num, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile) as total_count FROM signal_quality ) SELECT WeathProfile, AVG(SNQI) AS avg_snqi, (SELECT SNQI FROM ranked_quality WHERE WeathProfile = rq.WeathProfile AND row_num = (total_count + 1) / 2) AS median_snqi, SUM(CASE WHEN SNQI > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS analyzable_signals FROM ranked_quality rq GROUP BY WeathProfile ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC;

failures.question: I want to find signals that might contain structured information by analyzing their stability patterns. For each candidate, show the signal ID, signal type, Signal Stability Metric, one field that contains a combined stability textual report formatted exactly as: "Frequency: <frequency stability>, Phase: <phase stability>, Integrity: <signal integrity>" and the CIP Classification Label.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH computed AS (
    SELECT
        s.SignalRegistry,
        s.SignalClass,
        (1 - ABS(COALESCE(s.FreqDriftHzs, 0)) / (NULLIF(s.FreqMhz, 0) * 1000.0)) *
        (COALESCE(s.SigDurSec, 0) / (1.0 + ABS(COALESCE(s.DoppShiftHz, 0)) / 1000.0)) AS SSM,
        sc.EntropyVal,
        s.ModIndex,
        'Frequency: ' || COALESCE(sd.FreqStab, '') || ', Phase: ' || COALESCE(sd.PhaseStab, '') || ', Integrity: ' || COALESCE(sd.SigIntegrity, '') AS StabilityReport
    FROM signals s
    JOIN signaldynamics sd ON s.SignalRegistry = sd.SignalRef
    JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.SignalRegistry = sc.SignalRef
)
SELECT
    SignalRegistry AS "Signal ID",
    SignalClass AS "Signal Type",
    SSM AS "Signal Stability Metric",
    StabilityReport AS "Stability Report",
    CASE
        WHEN SSM > 0.8 AND EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND ModIndex > 0.5
            THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected'
        WHEN SSM > 0.6 AND EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9
            THEN 'Potential Information Pattern'
        ELSE 'No Clear Pattern'
    END AS "CIP Classification Label"
FROM computed
WHERE
    CASE
        WHEN SSM > 0.8 AND EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND ModIndex > 0.5
            THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected'
        WHEN SSM > 0.6 AND EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9
            THEN 'Potential Information Pattern'
        ELSE 'No Clear Pattern'
    END != 'No Clear Pattern';
failures.sol_sql: WITH stability_analysis AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.SignalClass, s.FreqDriftHzs, s.FreqMhz, s.SigDurSec, s.DoppShiftHz, s.ModType, s.ModIndex, sd.SigIntegrity, sd.FreqStab, sd.PhaseStab, sc.EntropyVal, ((1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs)/(s.FreqMhz * 1000)) * (s.SigDurSec/(1 + s.DoppShiftHz/1000))) AS SSM FROM Signals s INNER JOIN SignalDynamics sd ON s.SignalRegistry = sd.SignalRef INNER JOIN SignalClassification sc ON s.SignalRegistry = sc.SignalRef ), stability_attrs AS ( SELECT SignalRegistry, 'FreqStab' AS attribute, FreqStab AS value FROM stability_analysis UNION ALL SELECT SignalRegistry, 'PhaseStab' AS attribute, PhaseStab AS value FROM stability_analysis UNION ALL SELECT SignalRegistry, 'SigIntegrity' AS attribute, SigIntegrity AS value FROM stability_analysis ) SELECT sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, ROUND(sa.SSM, 3) AS SSM, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN sa.attribute = 'FreqStab' THEN 'Frequency: ' || sa.value WHEN sa.attribute = 'PhaseStab' THEN 'Phase: ' || sa.value WHEN sa.attribute = 'SigIntegrity' THEN 'Integrity: ' || sa.value END, ', ') AS stability_factors, CASE WHEN sa.SSM > 0.8 AND sa.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND sa.ModIndex > 0.5 THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected' WHEN sa.SSM > 0.6 AND sa.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9 THEN 'Potential Information Pattern' ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END AS pattern_assessment FROM ( SELECT sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, sa.SSM, sa.EntropyVal, sa.ModType, sa.ModIndex, stability_attrs.attribute, stability_attrs.value FROM stability_analysis sa JOIN stability_attrs ON sa.SignalRegistry = stability_attrs.SignalRegistry ) AS sa GROUP BY sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, sa.SSM, sa.EntropyVal, sa.ModType, sa.ModIndex;

failures.question: Classify signals by TOLS Category, and for each group, show the category name, signal count, average Bandwidth-to-Frequency Ratio, and the standard deviation of the anomaly score.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH computed AS (
    SELECT
        s.signalregistry,
        sp.TechSigProb * (1 - sp.NatSrcProb) * sp.SigUnique * (0.5 + sp.AnomScore / 10.0) AS TOLS,
        s.BwHz / (NULLIF(s.CenterFreqMhz, 0) * 1000000.0) AS BFR,
        sp.AnomScore
    FROM signals s
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN TOLS < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN TOLS < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS tol_category
    FROM computed
)
SELECT
    tol_category,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    AVG(BFR) AS avg_bfr,
    SQRT(AVG(AnomScore * AnomScore) - AVG(AnomScore) * AVG(AnomScore)) AS stddev_anomscore
FROM categorized
GROUP BY tol_category;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.TechSigProb * (1 - p.NatSrcProb) * p.SigUnique * (0.5 + p.AnomScore/10) < 0.25 THEN 'Low' WHEN p.TechSigProb * (1 - p.NatSrcProb) * p.SigUnique * (0.5 + p.AnomScore/10) < 0.75 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS tol_category, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, AVG(s.BwHz/(s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000)) AS avg_bfr, AVG(p.AnomScore*p.AnomScore) - AVG(p.AnomScore)*AVG(p.AnomScore) AS anomaly_stddev FROM Signals s JOIN SignalProbabilities p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef GROUP BY tol_category

failures.question: Which observatory stations are discovering the most potential technosignatures? For each station, display the observatory name, how many signals meet our technosignature criteria, their average TOLS score, average BFR values, and what percentage of all detected technosignatures they've found. I need this ranked by the stations with the most discoveries first.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH tech_signals AS (
    SELECT
        o.observstation,
        s.signalregistry,
        sp.TechSigProb,
        sp.NatSrcProb,
        sp.SigUnique,
        sp.AnomScore,
        s.BwHz,
        s.CenterFreqMhz
    FROM signals s
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref
    JOIN telescopes tel ON s.telescref = tel.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories o ON tel.observstation = o.observstation
    WHERE sp.TechSigProb > 0.7
      AND sp.NatSrcProb < 0.3
      AND sp.ArtSrcProb < 50
      AND (s.BwHz / (s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000.0)) < 0.001
      AND sc.InfoDense > 0.8
)
SELECT
    observstation AS observatory_name,
    COUNT(*) AS technosignature_count,
    AVG(
        TechSigProb 
        * (1 - NatSrcProb)
        * SigUnique
        * (0.5 + (CAST(AnomScore AS REAL) / 10.0))
    ) AS avg_tols,
    AVG(BwHz / (CenterFreqMhz * 1000000.0)) AS avg_bfr,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tech_signals) AS percentage_of_all_technosignatures
FROM tech_signals
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY technosignature_count DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH tech_signals AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.TelescRef, p.TechSigProb * ( 1 - p.NatSrcProb ) * p.SigUnique * ( 0.5 + p.AnomScore / 10 ) AS TOLS, s.BwHz / ( s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000 ) AS BFR FROM Signals AS s JOIN SignalProbabilities AS p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef WHERE p.TechSigProb > 0.7 AND p.NatSrcProb < 0.3 AND p.ArtSrcProb < 50 AND s.BwHz / ( s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000 ) < 0.001 ) SELECT t.ObservStation, COUNT(*) AS potential_tech_signals, AVG(ts.TOLS) AS avg_tols, AVG(ts.BFR) AS avg_bfr, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tech_signals ) AS percentage_of_total FROM tech_signals AS ts JOIN Telescopes AS t ON ts.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry GROUP BY t.ObservStation ORDER BY potential_tech_signals DESC NULLS FIRST

failures.question: Show me a breakdown of signal modulation types with at least 5 occurrences. For each modulation type, display the modulation type, the number of signals, the average Modulation Complexity Score (MCS), and average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Also include a detailed JSON with each signal's MCS and SNR values. Keys are the signal record IDs, and values are inner objects containing two fields: `mcs` – the signal’s MCS value, and `snr` – the SNR value.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH signal_mcs AS (
    SELECT
        s.SignalRegistry,
        s.ModType,
        s.SnrRatio,
        (s.ModIndex * (1 + (
            (1 - CASE WHEN s.FreqMhz IS NOT NULL AND s.FreqMhz != 0 
                      THEN ABS(COALESCE(s.FreqDriftHzs,0)) / (s.FreqMhz * 1000.0) 
                      ELSE 0 END)
            * (COALESCE(s.SigDurSec,0) / (1 + (COALESCE(s.DoppShiftHz,0) / 1000.0)))
        )) * CASE WHEN s.ModType = 'AM' THEN 2 
                  WHEN s.ModType = 'FM' THEN 1.5 
                  ELSE 1 END) AS mcs
    FROM signals s
    WHERE s.ModType IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ModType,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    AVG(mcs) AS avg_mcs,
    AVG(SnrRatio) AS avg_snr,
    json_group_object(SignalRegistry, json_object('mcs', mcs, 'snr', SnrRatio)) AS details
FROM signal_mcs
GROUP BY ModType
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY ModType;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT s.ModType, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, AVG(s.ModIndex * (1 + (1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs)/(s.FreqMhz*1000)) * s.SigDurSec/(1 + s.DoppShiftHz/1000)) * CASE WHEN s.ModType = 'AM' THEN 2 WHEN s.ModType = 'FM' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1 END) AS avg_mcs, AVG(s.SnrRatio) AS avg_snr, JSON_GROUP_OBJECT( s.SignalRegistry, JSON_OBJECT( 'mcs', s.ModIndex * (1 + (1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs)/(s.FreqMhz*1000)) * s.SigDurSec/(1 + s.DoppShiftHz/1000)) * CASE WHEN s.ModType = 'AM' THEN 2 WHEN s.ModType = 'FM' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1 END, 'snr', s.SnrRatio ) ) AS signal_details FROM Signals s WHERE s.ModType IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ModType HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

failures.question: Which observatories have the most promising signals worth investigating? I need a summary by observatory showing the observatory name, their total signal count, average Research Priority Index (RPI) and approximate Confirmation Confidence Score (CCS) values, number of high-priority (RPI > 3) signals, number of high-confidence signals, and especially the number of signals that meet both criteria. Sort the results by observatories with the most high-priority-and-high-confidence signals first.
failures.pred_sql:
SELECT
    o.observstation AS "Observatory Name",
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS "Total Signal Count",
    AVG(
        (CAST(sp.techsigprob AS REAL) * 4 + CAST(sp.biosigprob AS REAL)/100 + 
         CAST(sp.sigunique AS REAL) * 2 + CAST(sp.anomscore AS REAL)/2) * 
        (1 - CAST(sp.falseposprob AS REAL))
    ) AS "Average RPI",
    AVG(
        (1 - CAST(sp.falseposprob AS REAL)) * 
        CAST(d.decodeconf AS REAL) * 
        CASE 
            WHEN (CAST(s.snrratio AS REAL) - 0.1 * ABS(CAST(s.noisefloordbm AS REAL))) > 0 
            THEN (CAST(s.snrratio AS REAL) - 0.1 * ABS(CAST(s.noisefloordbm AS REAL)))/10 + 0.5 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END
    ) AS "Average CCS",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN (
        (CAST(sp.techsigprob AS REAL) * 4 + CAST(sp.biosigprob AS REAL)/100 + 
         CAST(sp.sigunique AS REAL) * 2 + CAST(sp.anomscore AS REAL)/2) * 
        (1 - CAST(sp.falseposprob AS REAL))
    ) > 3 THEN 1 END) AS "High-Priority (RPI>3)",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN (
        (1 - CAST(sp.falseposprob AS REAL)) * 
        CAST(d.decodeconf AS REAL) * 
        CASE 
            WHEN (CAST(s.snrratio AS REAL) - 0.1 * ABS(CAST(s.noisefloordbm AS REAL))) > 0 
            THEN (CAST(s.snrratio AS REAL) - 0.1 * ABS(CAST(s.noisefloordbm AS REAL)))/10 + 0.5 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END
    ) > 0.8 THEN 1 END) AS "High-Confidence (CCS>0.8)",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN (
        (CAST(sp.techsigprob AS REAL) * 4 + CAST(sp.biosigprob AS REAL)/100 + 
         CAST(sp.sigunique AS REAL) * 2 + CAST(sp.anomscore AS REAL)/2) * 
        (1 - CAST(sp.falseposprob AS REAL))
    ) > 3 AND (
        (1 - CAST(sp.falseposprob AS REAL)) * 
        CAST(d.decodeconf AS REAL) * 
        CASE 
            WHEN (CAST(s.snrratio AS REAL) - 0.1 * ABS(CAST(s.noisefloordbm AS REAL))) > 0 
            THEN (CAST(s.snrratio AS REAL) - 0.1 * ABS(CAST(s.noisefloordbm AS REAL)))/10 + 0.5 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END
    ) > 0.8 THEN 1 END) AS "Both High-Priority & High-Confidence"
FROM observatories o
JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
LEFT JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON sp.signalref = s.signalregistry
LEFT JOIN signaldecoding d ON d.signalref = s.signalregistry
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY "Both High-Priority & High-Confidence" DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH priority_calc AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, ( p.TechSigProb * 4 + p.BioSigProb / 100 + p.SigUnique * 2 + p.AnomScore / 2 ) * ( 1 - p.FalsePosProb ) AS RPI, ( 1 - p.FalsePosProb ) * d.DecodeConf * ( CASE WHEN s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) > 0 THEN ( s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) ) / 10 + 0.5 ELSE 0.1 END ) AS CCS_approx, o.ObservStation FROM Signals AS s JOIN SignalProbabilities AS p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef JOIN SignalDecoding AS d ON s.SignalRegistry = d.SignalRef JOIN Telescopes AS t ON s.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry JOIN Observatories AS o ON t.ObservStation = o.ObservStation ) SELECT ObservStation, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, AVG(RPI) AS avg_rpi, AVG(CCS_approx) AS avg_ccs, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE RPI > 3) AS high_priority_signals, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CCS_approx > 0.8) AS high_confidence_signals, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE RPI > 3 AND CCS_approx > 0.8) AS high_priority_high_confidence FROM priority_calc GROUP BY ObservStation ORDER BY high_priority_high_confidence DESC NULLS FIRST

failures.question: Create a report evaluating observatory conditions using the Atmospheric Observability Index (AOI) and identifying stations meeting Optimal Observing Window (OOW) criteria. The output should group stations by whether meets OOW (bool:True or False). For each group, you should provide its boolean value of OOW, the count of stations, average AOI (rounded to 3 decimal places) and a JSON array whose elements each include  `station` (observatory name), `aoi` (AOI value), `lunar_factors` object with `stage` (lunar stage) and `distance` (lunar distance), and `solar_status` (solar status).
failures.pred_sql:
WITH station_metrics AS (
  SELECT ObservStation,
         AtmosTransparency * (1 - HumidityRate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * WindSpeedMs) AS AOI,
         LunarStage,
         LunarDistDeg,
         SolarStatus
  FROM observatories
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN (AOI > 0.85 AND LunarStage IN ('New','First Quarter') 
          AND LunarDistDeg > 45 AND SolarStatus IN ('Low','Moderate')) 
    THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' 
  END AS meets_oow,
  COUNT(*) AS station_count,
  ROUND(AVG(AOI), 3) AS avg_aoi,
  json_group_array(
    json_object(
      'station', ObservStation,
      'aoi', AOI,
      'lunar_factors', json_object('stage', LunarStage, 'distance', LunarDistDeg),
      'solar_status', SolarStatus
    )
  ) AS stations_json
FROM station_metrics
GROUP BY meets_oow;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT is_optimal_window, COUNT(*) AS station_count, ROUND(AVG(aoi), 3) AS avg_aoi, JSON_GROUP_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT( 'station', ObservStation, 'aoi', ROUND(aoi, 3), 'lunar_factors', JSON_OBJECT( 'stage', LunarStage, 'distance', LunarDistDeg ), 'solar_status', SolarStatus )) AS observatory_details FROM ( SELECT o.ObservStation, o.AtmosTransparency * (1 - o.HumidityRate/100) * (1 - 0.02 * o.WindSpeedMs) AS aoi, o.LunarStage, o.LunarDistDeg, o.SolarStatus, CASE WHEN o.AtmosTransparency * (1 - o.HumidityRate/100) * (1 - 0.02 * o.WindSpeedMs) > 0.85 AND (o.LunarStage = 'New' OR o.LunarStage = 'First Quarter') AND o.LunarDistDeg > 45 AND (o.SolarStatus = 'Low' OR o.SolarStatus = 'Moderate') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_optimal_window FROM Observatories o ) GROUP BY is_optimal_window;

failures.question: Give me a ranked list of all our observatory sites by their current observation quality. For each observatory, I need fileds: the station name, telescope ID, calculated Observation Quality Factor, any equipment problems listed together sepearated by comma, how many issues there are, and the Observational Confidence Level. Please rank them by Observation Quality Factor with the best first.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH
calc AS (
    SELECT 
        o.observstation,
        t.telescregistry,
        t.equipstatus,
        t.calibrstatus,
        t.coolsysstatus,
        t.pointaccarc,
        (o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms)) AS AOI,
        ((1 - o.lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency)) AS LIF
    FROM observatories o
    JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
),
problems AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE WHEN equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN 'Equipment Status: ' || equipstatus END AS p1,
        CASE WHEN calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN 'Calibration Status: ' || calibrstatus END AS p2,
        CASE WHEN coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN 'Cooling System Status: ' || coolsysstatus END AS p3
    FROM calc
)
SELECT 
    observstation AS station_name,
    telescregistry AS telescope_id,
    (AOI * (1 - LIF) * (CASE WHEN pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2.0 / pointaccarc END)) AS OQF,
    COALESCE(p1, '') ||
    CASE WHEN p2 IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN p1 IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' ELSE '' END || p2 ELSE '' END ||
    CASE WHEN p3 IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (p1 IS NOT NULL OR p2 IS NOT NULL) THEN ', ' ELSE '' END || p3 ELSE '' END AS equipment_problems,
    (CASE WHEN p1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p3 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN AOI > 0.8 AND equipstatus = 'Operational' AND calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
        WHEN AOI BETWEEN 0.5 AND 0.8 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS OCL
FROM problems

WITH fan_interactions AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry,
        f.nicklabel,
        i.interactidolpivot AS idol_id,
        vi.nametag,
        e.engrate
    FROM fans f
    JOIN interactions i ON i.interactfanpivot = f.userregistry
    JOIN engagement e ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    JOIN virtualidols vi ON vi.entityreg = i.interactidolpivot
),
supported_idols AS (

        userregistry,
        idol_id

multi_idol_fans AS (
